29138.description:
JOB SUMMARY


 


The Pastry Chef is responsible for the overall management and success of the pastry and bakery operation. The role combines hands-on culinary expertise with strong leadership capabilities, ensuring the consistent production of high-quality pastries, desserts, cakes, breads, and specialty products while maintaining food safety standards, productivity, and cost controls.


Working closely with the Executive Chef and culinary leadership team, the Pastry Chef leads the development, training, and performance of the pastry team while continuously enhancing guest satisfaction and supporting the hotel's commercial objectives.


 


CANDIDATE PROFILE 


 


Education and Experience




Trade Certificate, Diploma, or Degree in Culinary Arts, Pastry Arts, Baking, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline preferred.


Minimum 4 years of professional pastry or bakery experience, including supervisory experience in a hotel, resort, restaurant, or large-scale catering environment.


International hotel experience is highly desirable.


Experience producing a wide range of pastries, cakes, desserts, breads, chocolates, and specialty confectionery products.




 


CORE WORK ACTIVITIES


 


Leading Pastry Culinary Team




Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.


Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.


Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.


Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.


Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.


Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.


Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.


Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.


Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.


Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.




 


Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met




Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.


Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.


Maintains food preparation handling and correct storage standards.


Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.


Supports procedures for food & beverage portion and waste controls.


Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.


Supervises pastry preparation shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.


Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.


Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.


Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.


Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.




 


Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service




Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.


Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.


Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.


Sets a positive example for guest relations.


Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.


Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.


Strives to improve service performance.




 


Maintaining Culinary Goals




Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.


Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.


Trains employees in safety procedures and supervises their ability to follow loss prevention policies to prevent accidents and control costs.


Purchases appropriate supplies and manage inventories according to budget.




 


Supports Training and Development Activities 




Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.


Participates in training staff on menu items including ingredients, preparation methods and unique tastes.


Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.


Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.


Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.




 


Additional Responsibilities 




Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.


Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.


Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.


Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.




 




 


 


 


To apply, click the link below:


 


 


https://careers.marriott.com/pastry-chef/job/P1-7570439-0


 


 


 


Please ensure you attach your updated CV and relevant documents.

29135.description:
Senior Lecturer


School of Accounting & Finance (SoAF) - Port Moresby, NCD


Position Title: Senior Lecturer
Department: School of Accounting & Finance (SoAF)
Location: IBSUniversity, 11 Mile Campus
Reports To: Head - School of Accounting & Finance


Employment Type: Full-Time


ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:


The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea. Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG) has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.


Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and futures citizens on Papua New Guinea.


A CAREER WITH US:


At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.


ABOUT THE ROLE


The Lecturer plays a pivotal role to ensure we have highly engaged and productive students that are enriched through education in unison to prosper in their life goals and achievements. As the gatekeeper of our student’s success, you will promote student management best practices that can be easily digested and embraced across the organization.


The Lecturer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a modern Academic function that is digital on the inside—harnessing digital + cloud technologies to effectively capture and manage all aspects of delivering the best student experience for the Institution. Overseeing and managing the entire lecturing process, you will ensure all students are engaged both academically and socially to maintain a healthy balance and effectively utilize our finite academic infrastructure resources. This position incorporates a high degree of unsupervised work; as an outcome focused person, you will display strong conflict resolution skills and enjoy managing your workload and being part of a productive team.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


In a highly student-focused role, the Lecturer should focus on strong collaboration, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. It is also essential that you understand Business and Management best practices and local industry trends. Lecturer duties will involve managing and monitoring undergraduate programs. This includes associated operational administration, curriculum development, course materials review and quality management and enhancement. Lecturer duties include but are not limited to the following:


Learning & Teaching




Ensure quality of tutor classes and complete the assigned syllabus within the scheduled time


Use all the available teaching aids for better understanding and delivery of the units


Ensure the benchmark for assistant lectures is achieved in the KPM’s at the end of the semester.


Tutor specific academic subjects to individuals or small groups


Monitor student’s attendance and progress


Use pre-determined Institution resources to deliver the tutoring as outlined




Lesson Preparation, Assessment & Examination Duties




Design, develop and prepare and conduct face-to-face, online and cooperative programs as allocated that inspire strong discussions and keep students interested and engaged.


Ensure that unit/course design and delivery comply with quality standards and regulations of the University and College


Assist in the conduct of examinations (e.g., paper setting, marking, supervision and invigilation)


Prepare and Submit DRMS in a timely manner




Student Learning Experience




Provide a high-quality learning experience to students, assisting them to achieve prescribed learning outcomes


Supervise student projects and academic elements of field trips as and when required


Supporting students’ extra-curricular activities


Coordinate meetings and schedules with tutees as appropriate




Research, Scholarship & Innovation:




Engage in research, scholarly activity and/or innovation, subject to the approval of the Head of School


Engage with other researchers internally, nationally & internationally to contribute to the research objectives of the respected School and Institutions research centres


To engaged in subject and professional research development as required and relevant to support teaching activities


Be active and recognized contributor to the subject association and relevant professional bodies.




Curriculum Development:




Develop & produce appropriate learning materials


Responsible for designing and delivery of modules and assessment methods


Develop course/unit materials of relevance to the highest quality for undergraduate programs.


Designing and delivery of Curriculum




General Duties:




Attend and present at relevant conferences and share knowledge and insights gained with the other schools when required


Liaise closely with teaching, technical, and administration.


Taking administrative responsibilities as requested by your Head of School, Division, and Registrar


Participate in professional development activities to improve tutorial skills and continue to grow cultural competence.


Provide support as a team member in other operational activities as and when requires


Participate in Institutions’ staff development initiatives relating to learning & teaching.




KEY SELECTION CRITERIA:


The following criteria are considered to be ESSENTIAL:




Master’s Degree or Higher in any of the following fields: Accounting, Business, Economics


Has 3 years’ experience in Teaching in Accounting, Business or economics courses.


Well-developed interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with students and all levels of employees and management


Excellent business judgment, analytical and decision-making skills


Ability to review programme design on a regular basis to ensure compliance with quality standards and academic regulations and to make alterations where appropriate.


Ability to demonstrate equivalent core knowledge in units taken


Ability to use a range of delivery techniques to enthuse and engage students


Capacity to develop and maintain effective working relationships with students, staff, management, other organizations and external stakeholders


Ability to communicate and impart complex conceptual ideas in a variety of way – presentations, reports, journal articles etc.


Ability to plan workloads and projects and manage resources effectively


Sound Computer skills







    	        
Apply

Location: Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea 
 
An exciting opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional to lead national business development across the electrical wholesale and solar sectors in Papua New Guinea.
 Global Talent Search is seeking an energetic, ambitious and results-oriented 
National Business Development Manager
 to join an established and highly regarded organisation in Papua New Guinea.
 This is an outstanding opportunity for a motivated B2B sales leader who thrives on building relationships, identifying commercial opportunities and driving revenue growth across a diverse customer base.
 Our client is looking for someone with genuine drive, a strong commercial mindset and the confidence to develop new business while strengthening existing customer relationships.
 About the Role Reporting to senior management, you will be responsible for driving national B2B sales growth across a comprehensive range of electrical products, equipment, cables, components and solar solutions.
 Working with commercial, industrial, construction, mining and trade customers, you will identify opportunities to supply electrical products for projects, infrastructure developments and ongoing operational requirements.
 
This is a hands-on, commercially focused position requiring a proactive approach to business development, customer engagement and sales leadership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 
Drive national business development and revenue growth across electrical wholesale and solar product categories.
 
Identify, develop and secure new B2B customers across commercial, industrial, construction and resources sectors.
 
Build strong relationships with contractors, electrical businesses, project managers, procurement teams and corporate customers.
 
Develop strategic sales plans to increase market penetration, revenue and profitability.
 
Identify major projects, tender opportunities and ongoing supply contracts.
 
Work closely with internal technical and product specialists to deliver effective customer solutions.
 
Negotiate commercial agreements, pricing and supply arrangements.
 
Maintain a strong sales pipeline, monitor performance and deliver against agreed revenue targets.
 
Represent the business professionally while building a strong presence across the PNG market.
 
 About You We are particularly interested in commercially astute sales professionals who combine industry knowledge with energy, ambition and a genuine passion for business development.
 
Ideally, you will offer:
 
 
A strong track record in B2B sales, business development or commercial sales management.
 
Experience within electrical wholesale, electrical contracting, industrial supplies, engineering products or related technical distribution sectors.
 
A good understanding of electrical products, cables, components, circuits and the requirements of commercial or industrial customers.
 
Exposure to solar products, renewable energy or associated electrical solutions would be advantageous.
 
Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills and the ability to identify profitable business opportunities.
 
A proactive, energetic and highly motivated approach to developing new business.
 
Excellent relationship management, communication and customer engagement skills.
 
The ability to operate independently, take ownership and consistently deliver results.
 
An understanding of Australian and New Zealand electrical standards, or a willingness to develop this knowledge.
 
 
An electrical trade or engineering background would be highly regarded but is not essential.
 Formal electrical engineering qualifications are not required, and technical product support and training will be available.
 
Above all, we are seeking a commercially driven individual with the right attitude, strong sales instincts and the determination to succeed.
 
The Opportunity 
This position offers the opportunity to make a significant commercial impact within an established business operating in an exciting and developing market.
 You will have the autonomy to build relationships, pursue new opportunities and contribute directly to the continued growth of a substantial national B2B operation.
 
Remuneration & Benefits:
 
 
Excellent Salary package depending on experience.
 
Attractive additional expatriate benefits, including accommodation and other allowances.
 
Opportunity to develop and grow a significant national sales portfolio.
 
Support from an established business with technical expertise and a broad product offering.
 
Single-status expatriate candidates preferred, although family arrangements may be considered.
 
 If you are an ambitious, commercially focused sales professional with experience in electrical products, industrial distribution or related B2B markets, we would welcome a confidential discussion.
 
Apply through Global Talent Search
 to explore this exciting career opportunity in Papua New Guinea.

29119.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.


 


 


Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.


 


We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.


 


Purpose


The 
Engineer Mechanical
 will provide mechanical engineering support across design, analysis, and modifications in the process plant and associated mine infrastructure, ensuring compliance with company specifications, operational requirements, agreements, and relevant standards.


 


Essential Duties


 




Provide mechanical and piping engineering design and calculations to relevant design codes and standards.


Review and investigate proposed mechanical and piping modifications within the process plant and mine site infrastructure and provide engineering guidance.


Conduct site inspections and prepare conceptual mechanical and piping design options for presentations to clients and stakeholders.


Prepare for review detailed drawings suitable for construction.


Liaise with inter-departmental clients, stakeholders and external consultants if necessary for design parameters and project requirements.


Identify and evaluate potential risks related to mechanical and piping designs and construction methodologies, implementing robust mitigation strategies to enhance safety and project viability.


Provide technical support during the construction and installation phases, ensuring installations are according to the design specifications.




Training & Experience




Bachelor’s Degree qualification in Mechanical Engineering


Registration with IEPNG (or eligibility)


Prior mechanical engineering experience in a mining, processing or heavy industry environment.


Understanding of project management principles.


Demonstrated competence in mechanical and piping design, with sound knowledge of relevant design codes and standards.


Strong capability to perform relevant engineering calculations to support designs.


Ability to read, interpret and review engineering drawings including general arrangement drawings, mechanical detail drawings,


Piping & Instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) and Piping Isometric drawings.


Capability to review engineering drawings and red-line in consultation with the design team to ensure accurate design and construction drawings.


Strong attention to detail and documentation capability.


Excellent planning and organizational skills.


Excellent communication skills and ability to work with minimal supervision


Good computer literacy and understanding of Microsoft software suite


Understanding of safety compliance and regulations


Valid Class 6 Driving License




Working Conditions


This is a FIFO role on a 21/21 roster.


 


At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.​


 


Learn more about our purpose and values: About Newmont​


Hear from our people: Life at Newmont​


 


Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team: 
[email protected]
.

Location: Lae, Papua New Guinea | Full-Time
 
Lead engineering and maintenance operations within a major FMCG business in Papua New Guinea.
 An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced 
Engineering Manager
 to join an established FMCG organisation based in Lae, Papua New Guinea.
 This senior leadership position will be responsible for overseeing engineering, maintenance, asset reliability and continuous improvement initiatives across a diverse operational environment.
 The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise, commercial awareness and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to drive operational efficiency, improve equipment performance and develop high-performing engineering teams.
 Key Responsibilities

Security Operations Manager – Highlands Region 
Location: Mt Hagen, Papua New Guinea
Employment Type: Full-Time
 
Global Talent Search is seeking an experienced and highly capable Security Operations Manager to oversee security operations, fleet coordination and safety compliance across multiple sites throughout the Highlands Region of Papua New Guinea.
 This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive security professional with strong operational leadership skills, extensive experience in risk management and the ability to manage security operations in challenging regional environments.
 The successful candidate will play a critical role in protecting people, assets and operations while ensuring effective security coverage, regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
 
Oversee and coordinate daily security operations across multiple sites throughout the Highlands Region.
 
Manage the deployment and performance of contracted security personnel and third-party security providers.
 
Lead incident response, emergency management and security investigations.
 
Conduct regular security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
 
Develop and maintain strong relationships with police, emergency services, government authorities and other key stakeholders.
 
Oversee regional fleet operations, including vehicle allocation, maintenance, utilisation and compliance.
 
Ensure adherence to workplace health, safety and security policies and regulatory requirements.
 
Monitor security contractor performance, service delivery standards and contractual obligations.
 
Coordinate emergency preparedness activities, including response planning and crisis management.
 
Prepare regular security, incident, fleet and compliance reports for senior management.
 
Drive continuous improvement in security procedures, operational efficiency and risk management practices.
 
 
Skills, Experience & Qualifications To be considered for this opportunity, candidates should demonstrate:
 
 
5–8 years of progressive experience in security operations, law enforcement or a related field.
 
At least 5 years of supervisory or management experience, ideally overseeing security operations across multiple locations.
 
A Diploma or Degree in Security Management, Law Enforcement, Risk Management or a related discipline.
 
Proven experience managing security operations in remote or regional environments.
 
Strong knowledge of incident management, emergency response, risk assessment and security compliance.
 
Experience in contractor management, security personnel coordination and operational planning.
 
Previous exposure to fleet management, vehicle coordination and associated compliance requirements.
 
Strong working relationships with police, law enforcement authorities and relevant government agencies.
 
Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
 
Sound computer literacy, including Microsoft Word and Excel.
 
A current Class 6 driver's licence.
 
 
Highly Desirable:
 
 
Security management experience within the mining, oil and gas, infrastructure, manufacturing or corporate sectors.
 
Experience managing large security contracts and geographically dispersed operations.
 
Formal training in crisis management, emergency response or security operations.
 
Knowledge of CCTV, GPS monitoring, access control and other security technologies.
 
Understanding of occupational health and safety requirements and relevant security management standards.
 
 We are looking for a confident, hands-on security professional who can remain calm under pressure, make sound decisions and respond effectively to operational challenges.
 You will be comfortable working across geographically dispersed locations, managing external security providers and engaging with senior management, law enforcement and community stakeholders.

Apply

29114.description:
Legal Manager
 
Port Moresby
 
 
The Opportunity
 
 
 
 Global Talent Search is partnering with a well-established financial institution in Papua New Guinea to recruit an experienced Legal Manager to join its in-house legal team in Port Moresby.
   
 This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded legal professional looking to further develop their career within the banking and financial services sector.
 Working closely with senior legal leadership and internal business stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical legal support across a broad range of commercial, regulatory and operational matters.
   
 The position offers exposure to banking operations, dispute resolution, regulatory compliance, commercial agreements and legal risk management within a professional and highly regulated environment.
 
 
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Provide practical and commercially sound legal advice across day-to-day business operations.
 
Manage legal disputes, claims and litigation matters, including coordinating with external legal counsel.
 
Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts, agreements and legal documentation.
 
Support lending, securities, debt recovery and enforcement matters.
 
Liaise with regulatory authorities, statutory bodies and relevant government departments.
 
Manage land-related legal matters, including engagement with the Department of Lands and Physical Planning.
 
Identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risks, ensuring compliance with applicable PNG legislation.
 
Assist with corporate governance, policy interpretation and regulatory requirements.
 
Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve legal matters efficiently.
 
Contribute to improvements in legal processes, documentation and compliance practices.
 
 
About You
 We are seeking a proactive and commercially minded legal professional who enjoys being hands-on and taking ownership of legal matters.
 
 
 
 
To be considered, you will ideally have:
 
 
A Bachelor of Laws (LLB) or equivalent recognised legal qualification.
 
Admission to practise in the National and Supreme Courts of Papua New Guinea, with current practising status.
 
Approximately 5–7 years or more of post-admission legal experience.
 
Experience in commercial law, banking, financial services or regulatory law.
 
Exposure to disputes, litigation management, recoveries or enforcement matters.
 
Strong legal drafting, negotiation and contract review skills.
 
Experience engaging with regulatory authorities and external legal counsel.
 
A sound understanding of PNG legislation and regulatory frameworks.
 
Strong communication, stakeholder engagement and organisational skills.
 
A Class 3 PNG driver's licence.
 
 Previous experience within a bank, regulated financial institution or reputable commercial law firm would be highly regarded.
   
 Candidates currently working as Legal Officers, Senior Legal Officers, Associates or Senior Associates who are ready to take the next step in their careers are encouraged to apply, provided they meet the experience and qualification requirements.
 
 
 
 
Why Consider This Opportunity?
 
 
Join an established financial institution with a strong presence in PNG.
 
Gain broad exposure to banking, commercial and regulatory legal matters.
 
Work closely with experienced legal professionals and senior business stakeholders.
 
Enjoy a varied, hands-on role with opportunities for professional development.
 
Build your career within a structured and professional banking environment.

29113.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.


Newmont's Port Moresby office plays an important role in supporting our business in Papua New Guinea and strengthening the connections between our operations, communities and stakeholders. Located in the nation's capital, the office brings together professionals who are passionate about creating positive outcomes for the country and its people. Working in Port Moresby means being part of a team that values partnership, respect and local leadership. Our people work closely with government, communities and industry partners to help create lasting benefits through responsible mining. It is a workplace that celebrates PNG's rich cultures and traditions, while providing opportunities to grow your career and contribute to an organisation committed to safety, continuous improvement and long-term value creation.










Your Impact






As an Officer, Regional Security, you'll help protect Newmont's people, assets and operations by maintaining effective security controls, supporting incident response activities and ensuring compliance with Newmont security standards. Working closely with government agencies, security partners and internal stakeholders, you'll contribute to a safe and secure operating environment while supporting investigations, access control and contractor compliance.










As Part of Our Team, You Will








Monitor and administer access control systems and support the implementation of company security policies and procedures.


Coordinate security requirements for residences, personnel and business travel, including security assessments and travel tracking activities.


Support the management and compliance of security contractors and service providers while ensuring alignment with Newmont security standards.


Support security incident response activities and assist with investigations into security breaches and irregularities.












Prerequisites for Your Success in This Role








Certificate, diploma or equivalent training in security management, criminal justice, law enforcement, military service or a related discipline; professional security certifications are advantageous.


Experience in security operations, access control, incident management, investigations support and implementation of security standards.


Knowledge of physical security principles, risk management, emergency response procedures and security compliance requirements.


Competency in the use of security technologies and tools, including CCTV, access control systems, incident reporting systems, databases and two-way radio communications.


Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively with government agencies, security providers and diverse external partners












Your Work Environment






This role is based in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea and is offered as a permanent position working a 5:2 Monday to Friday roster with 10-hour days. Reporting to the Lead, Regional Security, you will work closely with internal stakeholders, contracted security providers and a broad network of external partners including government agencies, law enforcement, emergency services, diplomatic representatives and aviation partners to support regional security outcomes.










Why Join Newmont






Working at Newmont means joining a high-performing team committed to safety, operational excellence and delivering sustainable value for our people, communities and business. 


Eligible employees may benefit from:
•    Competitive salary and annual performance incentive opportunities.
•    Access to health, wellbeing and employee assistance programs.
•    Ongoing learning, technical development and leadership training opportunities.
•    Exposure to large-scale mining operations and industry-leading technologies.
•    Career opportunities across Newmont's Australian, Papua New Guinean and global operations.
•    Access to a diverse range of on-site recreational, dining and wellbeing facilities.
•    The opportunity to be part of a workplace where safety, inclusion and growth are at the center of everything we do. 


Submit your application through our website quoting reference number 45076 before the advertised closing date: 16 November 2026.












At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.​






Learn more about our purpose and values: 
About Newmont
​
Hear from our people: 
Life at Newmont
​






Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team: 
[email protected]
.









    	        
Apply

29110.description:
With more than 40 years of experience working in PNG, World Vision International Papua New Guinea (WVIPNG) focuses on helping the most vulnerable children and adults experience fullness of life.  Inspired by our Christian faith, WVPNG has an exciting opportunity for someone who may be looking for a change and wants to become part of a dynamic team helping vulnerable people and communities.


World Vision International Papua New Guinea (WVIPNG) has exciting opportunity for those of you who want a change and want to become part of a dynamic team. We are currently looking for suitable, qualified, experienced, and highly motivated professional to fill the role of 
WASH Portfolio Manager 
to be based in 
Port Moresby, National Capital District, Papua New Guinea.
 The position reports to the Operations Director.


PURPOSE OF THE POSITION


The WASH Portfolio Manager will provide overall leadership, technical direction and management of World Vision PNG’s WASH Technical Program. The role will serve as the primary contact for the donor and key WASH sector stakeholders, while leading a team of senior staff to deliver grant activities and deliverables on time and to a high standard. The position will ensure effective program implementation, manage risks and promote sustainable outcomes that improve child wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities


Leadership and Grant Management




Set the strategic direction and vision for the WASH program.


Lead and oversee grant implementation, ensuring strategic objectives are achieved through effective program design, staffing, implementation and quality assurance.


Align the WASH program with the World Vision PNG Strategic Framework.


Develop a sustainable and ambitious WASH program strategy that attracts donor funding.


Identify grant management issues early and ensure timely and effective resolution.




Monitoring and Evaluation




Work with the Program Quality Manager to maintain an effective monitoring and evaluation (M&E) system that supports risk management, learning and accountability.


Collect, analyse and report monitoring data against standard indicators to key stakeholders.


Use monitoring evidence to inform program decisions and strategic direction.




Team Leadership and Capacity Building




Supervise a team of senior national and international staff across different technical areas.


Strengthen staff capacity to manage complex donor-funded projects.


Provide leadership and oversight to grant staff and short-term consultants.


Deliver WASH technical training to staff as required.




Financial and Risk Management




Manage the grant budget within approved limits and ensure financial reports to donors and Support Offices are accurate and submitted on time.


Ensure all expenditure is reasonable, correctly allocated and compliant with donor rules, financial management standards and applicable audit requirements.


Monitor technical budget lines closely to ensure expenditure remains within the approved budget.




Stakeholder Management




Manage the donor relationship in close collaboration with the Operations Director.


Build and maintain strong relationships with national and provincial government, NGOs, UN agencies and partners.


Represent World Vision at key stakeholder meetings and serve as the focal point at technical cluster meetings.


Lead the management of the WASH Cluster.




Qualifications, Experience and Requirements




At least eight years of experience in international development, including five years at management level on medium- to large-scale grant-funded projects.


Demonstrated experience leading WASH programs.


Strong knowledge of WASH issues and challenges in Papua New Guinea.


Proven ability to manage programs in complex political and cultural settings.


Experience coordinating teams across multiple locations.


Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong presentation and report-writing skills.


Relevant professional licences, as required by the technical field and donor.


A current driver’s licence and the ability to drive.


Commitment to World Vision’s Christian values and ethos.


A Master’s degree in Water Engineering or Civil Engineering.


A demonstrated track record of leading technical teams and building trust within diverse teams.


Knowledge of donor policies and requirements, particularly those of DFAT, UNICEF and the World Bank.


Willingness to travel to implementation sites and within the region as required.


Willingness to work in challenging security environments in accordance with World Vision’s security policies and procedures..




A competitive salary, benefits, and career development opportunity will be offered commensurate with relevant experience, knowledge, and qualifications.


Interested applicants should submit the following documents all in 
one PDF file
 before;
 Friday 13 November 2026
, 
(Midnight, PNG Time).




Expression of interest


Detailed CV




World Vision is committed to the principles of workplace diversity. Qualified women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.


World Vision is committed to safeguarding all children and adults living where World Vision operates. We enforce a zero tolerance policy for any forms of violence, abuse and exploitation against children or adults, either by employees or others affiliated with our work. We do not employ staff whose background is not aligned with our safe guarding practices. Employment is conditional upon successful completion of all mandatory background checks, including criminal record checks, where required.


We appreciate the time it takes to prepare your application. Please note that only short-listed candidates suitable for interviews will be contacted. If you do not hear from World Vision within 
two (2) weeks
 of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful.


Applicant Types Accepted:


Local and International Applicants (IA's) Accepted





    	        
Apply

29109.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


This position is responsible for carrying out electrical breakdown and preventative maintenance repairs on a wide range of mobile equipment’s including Light Vehicles, Boggers, Truck fleet, Excavators, Drills, Dozers, Graders, and support equipment.


Key Accountabilities




Performing scheduled and Breakdown maintenance on a large fleet of Underground Mining Equipment including Sandvik Drills, Trucks and Loaders with an ancillary fleet of CAT and Normet equipment.


Conduct regular electrical tests and tagging on equipment’s and machines.


Direct and train subordinates to install, maintain or repair electrical wiring, equipment’s, and machines.


Maintain safety work standards in accordance with government regulations and company policy.




About You 


To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a NATTB certified Trade certificate in Auto-electrical with at least 3-5 years of relevant work experience in heavy industry preferably mining environment. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.




Demonstrated experience in maintaining electrical equipment in the mobile fleet including Drills, Trucks, Loaders as well as Light vehicles, Dozers, excavators, graders,


Relevant experience in automotive air conditioning systems.


Self-motivated with ability to always work autonomously.


Strong safety focus and sound knowledge of standard operating procedures.




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

29094.description:
We are seeking to recruit for the position of 
Inventory Specialist
 for our 
Lae - Logistics Department
. Reporting to the Inventory Superintendent, the primary objective of this role is to deliver benefit through improved spares management, critical spares identification and cataloguing and overall assurance and coordination responsibilities.


The responsibilities include identifying opportunities for inventory optimisation, data cleansing/catalogue management, stock replenishment - reducing stock outs and critical consumables management as well as for the end-end disposals process.


The role will further require the elimination of all process control and non-performance issues through targeted coaching, root cause analysis and process improvements.


Key roles and responsibilities include:




Facilitate and self-manage inventory processes related to critical spares to ensure optimal availability


Focus on reducing critical spares stock outs and downtime through improved availability.


Ensure integrity and availability of inventory data in Pronto and required support systems (catalogue, re-order parameters, stock classification, stock-aging and performance level analysis).


Pro-actively identify and escalate material availability risks. Follow-up resolution with support functions to promote material availability.


Support the management of the obsolescence program to meet the annual inventory reduction targets.


Ensure compliance with the ANSI process for additions/changes is maintained. 


Support the review and maintenance of written procedures, SOP’s and templates for all inventory activities


Coach and train staff and provide functional guidance on safe and efficient completion of tasks up to acceptable standards.


Provide assistance with the preparation of departmental monthly reports, including activities in budget, safety and other relevant information.


Engage internal stakeholders to improve integrated demand planning and maintaining good relationships.


Ensure that inventory levels are determined, recorded, monitored, controlled and transacted in a collaborative and cost-effective manner to consistently satisfy operational requirements.


Coach customer departments on how they can contribute to increased inventory availability and optimised inventory related processes.


Support management of the inventory and inventory catalogue improvement plans to identify or improve spares stocking strategies


Implement data integrity procedures to ensure security of stock and accuracy of material availability.


Support the compliant execution of the annual stock count plan for all relevant warehouses


Ensure that all allocated activities comply with all legislative/statutory obligations, company policies, standards, and procedures.

Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.


Good computer skills

Honest, dependable, proactive, and able to meet deadlines.

29092.description:
Job Type:
 
Permanent
 
About us 


K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate. 


We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.


About the role


In this role you will assist the Technical Services Manager and Superintendents in providing a world-class ventilation service ensuring safe, efficient and complaint underground working conditions at our expanding underground gold mine in the Eastern Highlands of PNG. You will be a problem solver, with great attention to detail who thrives working on underground ventilation strategies, ventilation modelling and short- to long-term planning assistance. In addition, you will supervise, mentor and develop graduate ventilation engineers and technicians.


Key Accountabilities




Coordinate and manage daily, weekly, monthly and long-term ventilation activities, plans and reporting to achieve operational, safety, compliance and cost objectives.


Develop and maintain short-, medium- and long-term ventilation plans aligned with mine development schedules, production requirements and life-of-mine strategies.


Manage the Ventsim ventilation model, ensuring accurate representation of the underground ventilation network and using modelling and simulation to assess airflow, identify constraints and optimise system performance.


Develop, implement and maintain ventilation standards, procedures, design criteria and the Ventilation Management Plan in accordance with PNG mining legislation, statutory requirements and company standards.


Plan and coordinate ventilation infrastructure requirements, including primary and auxiliary fans, ventilation raises, airways, regulators, doors, ducting and associated systems.


Conduct and review ventilation surveys, monitoring programs, airflow assessments and performance reports to verify system effectiveness and compliance.


Identify, assess and manage ventilation risks relating to air quality, heat, dust, diesel particulate matter and other underground atmospheric hazards.


Integrate ventilation requirements into mine planning and scheduling to ensure adequate ventilation is available for planned development, production and future mining areas.


Identify ventilation improvement opportunities, infrastructure constraints and capital requirements, and develop strategies to support safe and efficient mine expansion.


Ensure ventilation changes are appropriately assessed, approved, documented and implemented through the site Management of Change process.


Maintain accurate ventilation plans, drawings, surveys, monitoring records, model outputs and statutory documentation.


Communicate ventilation plans, requirements, restrictions and changes effectively to Mine Operations and the underground workforce.


Provide technical advice to site management on ventilation performance, operational risks, infrastructure requirements and compliance matters.


Establish and maintain ventilation engineering standards, operating procedures, inspection requirements and technical specifications.


Regularly review ventilation processes, systems and standards to improve safety, reliability, efficiency and operational performance.


Ensure quality assurance and quality control of ventilation designs, calculations, modelling, surveys and technical deliverables.


Investigate ventilation deficiencies and system performance issues, implement corrective actions and monitor their effectiveness.


Support ventilation emergency preparedness, including the review of emergency response procedures and ventilation failure scenarios.


Provide direct supervision, leadership and performance management of the ventilation technician team.


Plan and coordinate technician activities, including ventilation surveys, inspections, monitoring, installations and maintenance support.


Establish work priorities, schedules and performance expectations to ensure timely completion of ventilation activities.


Ensure monitoring equipment is maintained, calibrated and fit for purpose.


Develop national ventilation technician capability through structured training, coaching, competency assessments and succession planning.


Develop a cohesive, accountable and technically competent ventilation team.


Understand and communicate site management priorities, operational requirements and business objectives.


Communicate clearly and effectively with Mine Operations, Technical Services, Maintenance and other departments to achieve safe and efficient outcomes.


Ensure ventilation systems and associated controls support a safe underground working environment and comply with applicable PNG mining legislation, statutory requirements and site standards.


Communicate regularly with team members regarding occupational health and safety matters and promote proactive hazard identification and risk management.


Conduct and oversee workplace inspections, audits and safety performance reviews to verify compliance with statutory and company requirements.


Ensure ventilation incidents, failures, hazardous atmospheric conditions and other safety events are promptly investigated, reported and communicated, with corrective actions tracked to completion.


Establish clear expectations for personal protective equipment and ensure employees receive appropriate training and equipment.


Manage and oversee relevant employee safety training and competency requirements.


Ensure ventilation risks are incorporated into risk assessments, operating procedures, emergency response planning and Management of Change processes.


Comply with environmental management requirements, sustainability measures and site policies.


Support environmental compliance through appropriate ventilation planning, monitoring and management of underground air quality and associated environmental risks.




About You 


To be considered for this role it is essential that you must have a bachelor’s degree in mining engineering and must have mining operational experience with 8 years of technical experience in a similar role. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.




Ability to register with the IEPNG as a professional member.


Sound working knowledge of DESWIK software is essential.


Expert use and knowledge of VentSIM software is essential.


Sound working knowledge of MS Office products including MS Access


Completion of 12 months underground time


Previous experience in Narrow Vein Mining 




Life at K92  


K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.


Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.


At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.


In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster. 


THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP 





    	        
Apply

Position Overview


The Salesperson is responsible for assisting walk‑in customers, processing sales orders, quotes and delivery dockets and ensuring excellent service at the counter. This role focuses on selling HVAC equipment, spare parts, and related accessories while supporting smooth counter operations and contributing to overall sales performance.


Key Responsibilities




Greet and assist walk‑in customers, technicians, and contractors at the counter.


Recommend appropriate products, spare parts, tools, and solutions based on customer needs.


Prepare and issue quotes, process delivery dockets, and handle EFTPOS transactions.


Do follow ups with customers on issued quotes


Ensure proper stacking and storage methods to prevent damage.


Label shelves, racks, and stock locations correctly.


Segregate fast-moving, slow-moving, hazardous, and obsolete items.


Learn and stay updated on new product lines, specifications, and promotions.


Coordinate with warehouse staff to ensure timely picking and delivery of counter orders.


Check stock availability and provide accurate information to customers.


Assist with stock checks, labelling, shelving, and maintaining a tidy counter area.


Process all sales documents accurately (dockets, EFTPOS receipts, quotations).


Maintain customer files and ensure correct pricing and product codes.


Follow company policies for returns, warranty claims, and special orders.


Work closely with warehouse staff, procurement, and management.


Communicate customer feedback, product issues, or supply concerns to supervisors.


Support overall branch sales goals and daily counter operations.


Follow all workplace health and safety guidelines.


Ensure safe handling of HVAC parts and materials, including refrigerants and electrical components.


Maintain a clean, safe, and professional counter environment.


Maintain cleanliness of warehouse, store, and surrounding areas.


Ensure aisles, walkways, and emergency exits are clear and unobstructed.


Arrange regular cleaning of storage racks, shelves, and floors.


Ensure proper waste disposal and removal of damaged packaging materials.




Personal Attributes




Friendly, approachable, and customer focused.


Reliable, organised, and proactive.


Willingness to learn technical products.


Team player with a positive attitude.




Qualifications & Experience




Grade 12 certificate preferred.


Experience in retail, trade counter sales, or technical sales an advantage.


Prior exposure to HVAC, mechanical, plumbing, or electrical products highly beneficial.


Experience in fast-paced customer service or parts counter work preferred.

SPECTRA POM IS HIRING!


Workshop Admin Officer


Spectra Industrial Limited - a Leader in Sales, Service and Hire of Forklifts, Gensets and Industrial Supplies, is seeking an organized, reliable and experienced individual to join our POM Branch Workshop team as Workshop Administration Officer, reporting to the Branch Manager.


Position Description




Position Title: Workshop Admin Officer


Company: Spectra Industrial


Location: Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea


Reports To: Branch Manager




Position Purpose


The Workshop Admin Officer is responsible for providing efficient administrative support to the workshop team, including customer service, job documentation, quotations, invoicing support, reporting, filing, staff coordination and timely communication with customers and internal departments. The role requires strong organization, accuracy, professionalism and the ability to manage priorities in a busy workshop environment.


Key Responsibilities




 Customer Service & Workshop Administration






Provide professional and responsive customer service to workshop clients and internal teams.


Maintain accurate workshop records, job cards, files and service documentation.


Receive, record and follow up customer enquiries, job requests and workshop updates in a timely manner.






 Quotations, Invoicing & Job Documentation






Assist with preparation of quotations, invoices and supporting documents for workshop jobs.


Ensure job information, purchase orders, labour details and parts usage are recorded accurately.


Work with Operations, Accounts and workshop staff to support timely billing and job closure.






 Reporting, Scheduling & Follow Up






Prepare and maintain workshop reports, including work-in-progress updates as required.


Assist with scheduling, tracking and follow-up of workshop jobs to support completion deadlines.


Communicate job status updates clearly to supervisors, customers and relevant departments.






 Workshop Team Support






Provide administrative support to workshop supervisors, technicians and operations staff.


Assist with coordination of materials, job updates and communication between workshop and office teams.


Support a safe, organized and efficient workshop administration process.






 General Administration






Maintain filing systems, registers, records and administrative documents accurately.


Assist with data entry, correspondence, emails and document preparation as required.


Prioritize daily tasks, work under pressure and meet prompt reporting deadlines.




Key Competencies & Skills




Excellent interpersonal, written communication and customer service skills.


Strong organizational ability, attention to detail and accuracy in record keeping.


Ability to multitask, prioritize work and manage time efficiently.


Able to work under pressure, meet deadlines and coordinate effectively across teams.


Professional, proactive, reliable and well-motivated.




Qualifications & Experience




Year 12 education or higher educational background.


Previous experience in administration, workshop support, service coordination or a related role.


Basic understanding of workshop operations, job documentation and customer service processes.


Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Outlook and Excel.

Zenag Chicken is the longest established and leading producer of high-quality chickens and eggs in PNG.  Established in 1946 with its corporate HQ in Lae Industrial Centre and Poultry Farm based outside of Lae which supplies quality eggs and chicken throughout PNG.


 


We are looking for a qualified Auto Electrician who will be reporting to the Workshop Manager. You will be working in the workshop department which is Farm Base and any other areas where there is a breakdown of company vehicle that require auto electrical work.


 


Duties: 




Responsible for battery charging, repair and replacements of starter and alternator, wiring and replacements of bulbs and lamps.


Responsible of all machine’s electrical components


Ensuring to maximize the availability of all company fleets and equipment.


Ensuring inventory of the auto electrical materials are maintained.


Ensuring housekeeping is done after completed task.




 


Skills and Specifications


 




Trade certificate/diploma in Automotive/Auto-Electrical from a recognized technical school


Recognized tradesman certificate


Minimum of five (5) years’ experience as an auto electrician.






Good understanding of electrical/electronic circuit troubleshooting


Experience in Electronic Diagnostic Tools, familiar in Cummins, Toyota, ISUZU, Komatsu, JCB, Hyundai.


Have extensive knowledge of Kenworth’s Trucks


Physically fit & Safety cautious to work in the workshop.






Must be flexible with working hours.


Must possess good communication skills.




If this sounds like you, apply now with your CV and a one-page cover letter with three current references/referees to 
[email protected]


Please do not include all your certificates with your application but list them in your CV.


 


ONLY short-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.


 


If you don’t receive any calls from us within a week after the closing date, it means your application was not considered for an interview.


 


Closing date for submissions is Friday 13th November 2026.


 





            

        
Apply

29080.description:
Islands Petroleum
 is an independently owned fuel and lubes distributor, and the exclusive distributor for Mobil lubricants in Papua New Guinea. With the head office based in Kokopo, Islands Petroleum also operates bulk fuel depots in Rabaul, Kimbe, Konebada, Kavieng, Alotau, Popondetta/Oro Bay and Mt. Hagen as well as lubes and fuel distribution warehouses in Lae, Port Moresby, and Madang. 


We are currently seeking a 
Lead Engineer - Momase & Highlands
 Region to be based at our 
Lae Dept, Morobe Province. 


 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Engineering Coordination and Delivery




Lead and coordinate assigned engineering projects, asset improvements and infrastructure upgrades.


Develop and maintain regional or portfolio engineering work plans and resource schedules.


Review project scopes, specifications, designs, cost estimates and execution methodologies prepared by Project Engineers.


Resolve routine technical issues and escalate complex matters to the Senior Engineer.


Coordinate technical interfaces between Engineering, Operations, HSE, Commercial, Procurement and contractors.


Support engineering reliability improvements and resolution of recurring equipment problems.




B. Project Management Oversight




Supervise Project Engineers in planning, procurement, execution, commissioning and closeout.


Monitor project budgets, schedules, progress, quality and contractor performance.


Review contractor claims, variations and progress certifications before recommendation to higher management.


Ensure project risks, delays and cost deviations are identified and reported promptly.


Verify project documentation, quality records, testing and handover requirements are completed.




C. People Management




Supervise and appraise Project Engineers.


Allocate project assignments based on priorities, capability and available resources.


Conduct regular project performance reviews and technical coordination meetings.


Mentor junior engineers and identify training requirements.


Promote teamwork, accountability and timely communication.




D. HSE And Operational Support




Ensure engineering projects implement approved risk assessments, permit-to work controls and safe work procedures.


Conduct periodic project site inspections and management safety interactions.


Support incident investigations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.


Coordinate with Operations to minimize disruption to depot and customer fuel supply activities.




Delegated Authority




Assign work to Project Engineers within approved plans.


Review and endorse project engineering submissions for escalation.


Coordinate approved contractor works and engineering resources.


Recommend contractor progress claims, variations and procurement requirements.


Require correction of nonconforming work and exercise Stop Work authority.


Escalate technical decisions outside approved standards or personal competence.


Financial authority: Limited to the approved IPL DOA and specific written project delegations.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE




Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.


Preferably 7-10 years of relevant engineering experience.


At least 3 years in project leadership, engineering coordination or supervision.


Experience with fuel terminals, industrial piping, storage tanks, pumps, mechanical and electrical installations, or similar facilities.


Working knowledge of project management, contractor supervision, engineering documentation and cost control.


Strong understanding of engineering principles and processes


Strong technical and problem-solving skills


Ability to mentor and guide junior engineers


Excellent communication and interpersonal skills


The ability to work effectively in a team environment


Good behavior and demonstrated Leadership




 


ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES


Project leadership, technical coordination, construction methodology, cost control, scheduling, contractor management, problem-solving, team development, safety leadership and reporting.


 


Ready to take the next step in your engineering career?


Apply now and contribute to the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of engineering projects across Islands Petroleum.


Click the Link / Apply icon to submit your application.


Lead Engineer - Momase & Highlands


Applications will close on the 12th of November 2026. 





    	        
Apply

29079.description:
Credit Corporation PNG is recruiting a suitable candidate for the role of 
Technology Risk Specialist.


 


The Technology Risk Specialist is responsible for conducting risk- analysis and reporting of information obtained from multiple sources such as system generated transactions, IT monitoring applications and other risk registers.


The Technology Risk Specialist will collaborate with the relevant business units within Credit Corporation as part of the second line risk function ensuring that technology risk controls are embedded and tested to be operating effectively.


The role reports into the Head of Enterprise Risk Management and acts as a risk business partner to the IT team. The role is based in Port Moresby.


 


Primary Responsibilities:




Help oversee and implement risk mitigation programs, controls and governance in relation to technology risk.


Regularly undertake reviews of IT risks to ensure the IT risk register is current and reflective of the business environment.


Undertake 2nd line control tests to ensure effectiveness and works with the first line to remediate where needed.


Manage IT Risk Appetite Statements reporting in collaboration with the IT team.


Report on issues and execute governance programs to ensure actions are closed within deadlines.


Investigate, escalate and report IT related incidents ensuring the identified control gaps are remediated.


Collaborate with the IT team to ensure disaster recovery readiness from a second line perspective.


Provide advisory to stakeholders on IT risk management practices


Provide IT risk reporting to management and the board as required


Operate as second line defense to ensure technology risk is managed within appetite.


Coordinate enterprise-wide IT risk awareness programs.


Collaborate with the IT team for the management of IT related policies and procedures.




 


Other Duties




Other duties as directed or required by the Head of Enterprise Risk Management or Chief Risk Officer.




 


 Key Overall Competencies




Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science or IT




 


Formal Qualifications


Mandatory:




Bachelor’s degree in IT or Computing Science


IT or Inform Security Risk Management certification advantageous – CRISC, CISA, CISM, ISACA etc




Knowledge required:




Banking or risk reporting knowledge


Prior IT Governance or risk reporting experience is desirable


Advanced MS Excel and proficiency with other data management tools


Experience with Portecht system advantageous


Knowledge of risk and data governance fundamentals.




 


Experience:




Minimum 3yrs in risk management, Information Technology or compliance


Banking, IT or risk reporting experience is advantageous


Sound knowledge of Technology and Cyber security regulations and industry standards


Advanced MS suite skills and proficiency with data management tools


Experience with developing and reviewing policies


Prior experience in banking or finance is an advantage


Knowledge of cloud technologies is an advantage


Self-starter and experience working across teams and stakeholders


Prior experience working with IT risk and governance policies desirable


Prior experience in IT projects advantageous

If you think you have what it takes to be in this role, we would like to hear from you.

29077.description:
Senior leadership role with direct CEO and Board engagement.
Drive financial strategy, governance and risk management.
PNG Nationals are encouraged to apply
Finance and Investment Manager
Location:
 Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Finance & Investment Manager to lead the financial management and investment functions of an established organisation in Papua New Guinea.
 This senior leadership position is suited to a commercially astute finance professional with a strong background in financial strategy, investment oversight, treasury, financial governance and regulatory compliance. 
Working closely with the CEO and Board, you will play a key role in protecting financial assets, strengthening investment performance and supporting the organisation's long-term financial sustainability.
 
About the Role
 
As Finance & Investment Manager, you will oversee the organisation's financial management and investment activities, ensuring strong financial governance, effective risk management and accurate reporting.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Lead annual budgeting, financial planning, forecasting and financial performance monitoring.
 
Oversee monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting for senior management and the Board.
 
Manage investment activities, assess investment opportunities and monitor portfolio performance, returns and associated risks.
 
Oversee cash flow, treasury operations, liquidity and working capital requirements.
 
Maintain robust financial controls and ensure compliance with relevant statutory, regulatory and accounting requirements.
 
Coordinate external audits and oversee the timely resolution of audit findings and recommendations.
 
Prepare investment recommendations and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making.
 
Monitor investment risks, counterparties, liquidity and compliance with approved investment policies.
 
Develop and maintain effective relationships with banks, investment managers, auditors and other key stakeholders.
 
Lead and develop the Finance and Investment team, including staff performance management and capability development.
 
Provide financial advice to support business planning, strategic initiatives and organisational growth.
 
Contribute to corporate strategy and initiatives that strengthen financial sustainability and operational performance.
 
 
About You
 
You are an experienced finance leader with the technical expertise, commercial judgement and leadership capability to oversee complex financial operations and provide strategic advice to senior management and the Board.
 You will bring a combination of strong financial management expertise, investment knowledge and a sound understanding of governance, risk and regulatory compliance.
 
To Be Successful in This Role, You Will Have
 
 
A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, Investment Management or a related discipline.
 
At least seven years of relevant professional experience, ideally within financial services, banking, a financial institution or a similarly regulated environment.
 
Demonstrated experience in financial management, budgeting, forecasting and statutory financial reporting.
 
Strong knowledge of investment management, portfolio performance, investment risk assessment and treasury operations.
 
Experience contributing to investment strategies and providing financial recommendations to senior management or Board committees.
 
A sound understanding of financial governance, internal controls, audit processes and regulatory compliance.
 
Experience managing relationships with banks, financial institutions, auditors and other key stakeholders.
 
Proven leadership capability, including developing teams, managing performance and improving financial processes.
 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and provide sound commercial advice.
 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of clear and concise reports for executive and Board-level stakeholders.
 
High levels of integrity, accountability, attention to detail and professional judgement.
 
 This is an opportunity to take on a key financial leadership position within an established organisation in Papua New Guinea.
 You will have the opportunity to contribute to strategic decision-making, oversee critical financial and investment functions, work closely with senior leadership and the Board, and help strengthen the organisation's long-term financial performance and sustainability.
 
How to Apply
 
If you are an experienced finance professional looking for your next leadership opportunity in Papua New Guinea, we would welcome your application.
 For a confidential discussion about this opportunity, please get in touch.





    	        
Apply
